name: us032-accept-site-replay
description: 032 SC-008 / C3.7: the refusal's own instruction is not the bypass. Run 1 binds this checkout to the site the ceremony reaches. Run 2 points config.yml at a different site and reconciles — refused, exit 4, zero requests, naming both origins. Run 3 does exactly what that refusal's prose says: it runs the ceremony, WITHOUT --accept-site. It must refuse too, record nothing and issue zero requests, or an attacker who redirected base_url only has to wait for the operator to follow the printed advice. The ceremony's check runs BEFORE discovery, which is what makes run 3 expressible here: the redirected host is never contacted, so the two backends (a curl shim on the Bash side, a real socket on the PowerShell side) cannot disagree about its reachability. The positive half — accepting by name — stays per-port for that same reason and is covered by test_config_bound_site.bats / Config.BoundSite.Tests.ps1. SPEC_KIT_JIRA_BASE_URL is blanked throughout: the harness exports the mock URL by default and FR-011 exempts an environment-supplied destination.

write..specify/jira/config.yml:
base_url: "https://moved.example.invalid"
# Team config for the reconcile bridge (committable, credential-free).

    style: company_managed
    priority_map:

      P2: Medium
      P3: Low
routing:

      folder_prefix: "billing-"
    project: COMP
routing_default: COMP
